div.head: III Eg 3
div.ab: [Be unrihtum dome.] [Ld] ⁊ se dema, þe oðrum woh deme, gesille þam cynge hundtwelftig scill' to bote—buton he mid aðe gecyðan durre, þæt he hit na rihtor ne cuðe—sy þolige áá his þegenscipes, buton he hine æt ðam cynge gebicge, swa he him geþafian wille; ⁊ ofmanige scirebiscop þa bote to ðæs cynges handa.

And a judge who gives a false judgment against another man shall pay 120 shillings as compensation to the king, unless he is prepared to declare an oath that he did not know how to give a more just decision; and he shall forfeit forever his rank as thegn, unless he redeem it from the king on such terms as the king will allow him. And the bishop of the diocese shall extract the compensation on the king's behalf.

⁊ se dema, se ðe oðrum on woh gedeme, gesylle þam cynge hundtwelfti scill' to bote – butan he mid aðe gecyðan durre, þæt he hit na rihtor ne cuðe – ⁊ þolige á his þegnscipes, butan he hine eft æt þam cynge gebigge, swa he him geðafian wille; ⁊ ámanige þære scyr biscop þa bote to ðæs cynges handa.
